title: Epstein-Barr virus based biomarkers and targeted therapies in nasopharyngeal carcinoma: a narrative review.
publicationName: The Lancet regional health. Western Pacific
journalName: The Lancet regional health. Western Pacific
snippet: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is a human malignancy with well-established association with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection. Due to the concealed anatomical location of nasopharynx and the absence of early-stage clinical symptoms, most patients are diagnosed at a relatively advanced stage. title: Pathological Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential of Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Heart Failure.
snippet: Heart failure (HF) is a clinical syndrome resulting from structural or functional cardiac abnormalities and represents a growing global public health challenge. Common etiologies include myocardial infarction, cardiomyopathy, and myocarditis.
